# Food Buff: Radhog Burnt Ends

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 13, 2025
- 2 min read

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_446c2cee857d4b15916b86f4565fe9c7~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_58d20f8ed21346a295a33b97ea887e55~mv2.jpg)

**Buff**

| **Base Buff** | **Carnivore Mutation** | **Mutation and SIN Perk Card** | **Duration** | 
| +10 AP regen | +20 AP regen | +25 AP regen | 60 minutes | 

**Glowing Gut Perk Card**

Note: Carnivore mutation removes radiation from meat-based foods, so Radhog Burnt Ends will NOT give rads if the player has the Carnivore mutation.

| **Perk Rank** | **Total Rads** | 
| None | 2 Rads | 
| Rank 1 | 4 Rads | 
| Rank 2 | 6 Rads | 
| Rank 3 | 8 Rads | 

**Spoil Rate**

| **Food Type** | **Base** | **30% Reduced** | **50% Reduced** | **60% Reduced** | **90% Reduced** | 
| Tasty Meat Large | 6h 0m | 7h 48m | 9h 0m | 9h 36m | 11h 24m | 

**Weight**

1.5 pounds

**How to obtain**

**Recipe**

Complete the Lifetime Challenge: **Cook 30 meals that use Radhog Meat.**

**Cooked Dish**

May in Highway Town in Burning Springs - Radhog Burnt Ends - 27.39%

**Recipe**

2x Wood

1x Nuka-Cherry

1x Spices

2x Prickeye

5x Radhog

**Workbench**

Cooking Station > Meat

Cooking Station > All Food

**Stacking**

This is a food buff, so it will not stack with other AP Regen food buffs.

It will stack with chems, alcohol, bobbleheads, magazines, and all other non-food categories.

**Technical**

**Form ID**

0084B86C

**Hunger Bar Restore**

2500 points

**Thirst Bar Restore**

0 points

**Radiation**

2 Rads

**Value**

30 caps

**Persists on server hop**

Yes

**Persists on death**

Not specified

**Keywords**

Object Type Food

Ingredient Type Meat

Meal Type Cooked

Object Type Can Spoil
